    # Keep each distinct horizontal/vertical stripe and one representative

    # In these patterns stripes are constant-color rows/columns; detect rows

    # share the same repeated pattern. Select rows where a color occupies all
    # but a few crossing positions.
    row_stripes = [r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) > 1 and sum(row.count(v) for v in set(row)) == len(row)]
    # More direct: stripe rows contain a dominant repeated color beyond the
    # vertical stripe locations; identify unique rows not equal to the mode.
    patterns = {}
    for r,row in enumerate(grid): patterns.setdefault(tuple(row), []).append(r)
    stripes = [r for r in range(len(grid)) if sum(grid[r][c] == grid[r][0] for c in range(len(grid[r]))) >= len(grid[r])-4 and len(set(grid[r])) > 1]
    # Generic stripe detection: rows with a color occupying a long contiguous run.
    rs = [r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) > 1 and max(row.count(v) for v in set(row)) >= len(row)-4 and tuple(row) not in [k for k,v in patterns.items() if len(v)>1]]
    # Task structure: detect stripe rows as rows whose values are mostly one color;
    # columns similarly. In cases with repetitive backgrounds, this distinguishes them.
    rs = [r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if max(row.count(v) for v in set(row)) >= len(row)-4 and len(set(row)) > 1]

    def picks(n, marks):
        out=[]; start=0
        for m in marks:
            if start < m: out.append(start)
            out.append(m); start=m+1
        if start<n: out.append(start)
        return out
